title: The b-cap-boundary-strict defect, hidden inside a realistic multi-hunk commit
changeCommitMessage: limits: treat a non-positive cap as no cap at all
claim: withinCap in src/limits.mjs now treats a cap of zero or less as unlimited and returns true, instead of blocking every item under a misconfigured cap. test/limits.test.mjs covers the unlimited case and passes.

defect.summary: roomFor, changed by the same commit as part of the isUnlimited routing but absent from the claim, now uses `used + size < cap` instead of `<= cap`, so an item that exactly fills the remaining capacity is wrongly rejected. The error appears only at the exact boundary.
